description: Create an Airflow DAG for logistics_co that computes weekly carrier scorecards using a custom timetable or cron such that each run covers Monday 00:00 to the following Monday 00:00 UTC, and runs on Monday at 06:00 UTC after the week ends. The DAG must: (1) derive week_start and week_end explicitly from the data interval rather than assuming it, (2) aggregate on-time delivery rate per carrier for deliveries with delivered_at in [week_start, week_end), (3) write to a table keyed by (carrier_id, week_start), using delete-then-insert, (4) support backfill of the last 52 weeks.

expected_behavior.start_date: first Monday of the backfill range

edge_cases: With cron '0 6 * * 1' the data interval is Monday 06:00 to Monday 06:00, not midnight to midnight; using it directly shifts the week by 6 hours
On-time rate denominator is delivered shipments in the week; undelivered shipments are excluded and must not be counted as late
Carriers with zero deliveries in a week should have no row rather than a 0% or NULL rate row
ISO week numbering at year boundaries: key on week_start date instead of (year, week_number)
Deliveries with NULL promised_at must be excluded from both numerator and denominator and counted separately
common_failure_modes: FM2: Using data_interval_start/end directly yields a Monday 06:00 based week
FM3: Averaging daily on-time rates instead of dividing weekly totals weights low-volume days equally
FM3: NULL promised_at rows fall into the denominator as not on time
